answers.core: This is a simple workflow improvement that would be overkill for an asset.
answers.workaround: In some applications you could directly reference nodes in the scene with the $ operator and manually add them into an array in _onready but that is clunky and less flexible. I believe this will improve workflow for any scene that needs a lot of node `@export`, especially ones that need arrays.

title: Improve workflow when adding elements to an @export array
